\item \textit{Notes:} Values report sample mean $\pm$ sample standard deviation ($ddof=1$) over Seeds 42, 43, 44. In this controlled setting, component weights are held constant at their production ratios ($9/13$ and $4/13$) without re-normalization. Baseline uniform client aggregation share is $1/K = 20.0\%$. Attacker weight $w_0$ measures the malicious client's share in the global model. Removing the update channel increases ASR across all datasets (+1.19% Cora, +0.28% PubMed, +11.11% Reddit), proving its non-redundant dynamic role. Removing the topology channel causes catastrophic defense breakdown on Cora (42.53% ASR) and Reddit (66.31% ASR), proving parameter-space anomaly detection alone cannot stop structural backdoors.
